completionNarrative:
**Summary:**

The defect was a one-character typo in `plugins/codex/scripts/codex-companion.mjs` in the `normalizeRequestedModel` function:

```diff
-  if (model != null) {
+  if (model == null) {
```

This function's purpose is to return `null` when no model is provided, and otherwise look up aliases (e.g., `"spark"` → `"gpt-5.3-codex-spark"`). With the reversed comparison (`!=`), any non-null model value caused an immediate `return null`, so passed model options were silently discarded. The test "task forwards model selection and reasoning effort to app-server turn/start" expected `fakeState.lastTurnStart.model` to equal `"gpt-5.3-codex-spark"` but got `null` because the alias lookup was never reached.

Fixed by changing `!=` to `==`. All 91 tests now pass.
